name: CasePseudoInsetRingAbsentHostClear
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "pseudo-inset-ring-absent-host-clear" (pseudo-elements). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: the coincident inset ring of pseudo-inset-ring-two-axis, but `[data-appearance="ghost"]::after { display: none }` REMOVES the ring box in a THIRD of the domain — and in exactly those combos the host's own `border-color` is `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)`, so a folded width there paints nothing
